correctness.rationale: The finite object and proof certificate are reconstructed from the Paley-\(29\) definition. The verifier exhausts all 841 nonempty faces, checks all 397 matched pairs and all 2436 Hasse covers, proves the Morse orientation acyclic by topological sorting, reconstructs the signed \(37\times9\) Morse boundary, and verifies a unit \(8\times8\) minor, a determinant-2 full-rank minor, and mod-2 rank 8. These facts force Smith invariant factors \(1^8,2\) and hence the claimed CW decomposition. An independent mod-2 calculation on the original simplicial chain complex gives boundary ranks \((28,175,202)\), consistent with the Moore summand.

value.rationale: \(P_{29}\) is a canonical highly symmetric Paley graph and the next prime-order Paley graph after the published \(P_{17}\) vertex-decomposable example. The exact result detects a genuine torsion phenomenon: a \(\mathbb Z/2\) Moore summand rather than only a sphere wedge. That gives a natural finite benchmark for topology of independence/clique complexes of quadratic-residue graphs, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a mere recount of known graph invariants.
